title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
statement: Design a codec to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. Your codec should be able to convert a binary tree into a string representation and back to the original tree structure. The serialization format should be unambiguous so that the deserialized tree matches the original.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 10^4]

visibleExamples.explanation: The tree is serialized using pre-order traversal with 'N' representing null nodes.
An empty tree serializes to a single null marker.

jsonFriendlyReason: The serialize method takes a TreeNode (requires custom adapter) and returns a string; the deserialize method takes a string and returns a TreeNode (requires custom adapter).
